But this time, things are much, much worse.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/29/ralph-nader-midterm-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/oct/29/economy-growth-third-quarter</link>
      <description><p>Commerce department data contrasts with sharp deterioration in consumer sentiment as midterms loom</p><p>The US economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter while inflation accelerated in September, according to new commerce department data released on Thursday, less than a week before the midterm elections that will determine control of Congress.</p><p>Gross domestic product (GDP) increased at a 3.4% annualized rate last quarter, the commerce department’s ⁠bureau of economic analysis said in its advance estimate of the third-quarter GDP on Thursday.       <title>FTC orders Delta, Uber and others to hand over data on algorithmic pricing</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/29/delta-uber-ftc-pricing</link>
      <description><p>Regulator demands companies explain how and why they charge different prices for the same product or service </p><p>The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is demanding some of the US’s biggest airlines, ride-share companies and retailers divulge how they are using algorithms and loyalty programs to target customers and drivers with different prices and wages.</p><p>Nine companies – Delta, United, JetBlue, Lyft, Uber, DoorDash, Instacart, Target and Walmart – were named in the inquiry, which comes after <a href="https://www.consumerreports.org/money/questionable-business-practices/instacart-ai-pricing-experiment-inflating-grocery-bills-a1142182490/">investigations</a> and lawsuits alleging consumers are charged different prices based on their buying histories and drivers <a href="https://www.courthousenews.com/uber-drivers-claim-personal-data-used-to-manipulate-fares/">paid different fares</a> based on their personal histories.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/29/delta-uber-ftc-pricing">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Europe’s central bank chief, Christine Lagarde, steps down for ‘freedom of speech’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/29/european-central-bank-chief-christine-lagarde-to-step-down-nine-months-early</link>
      <description><p>Possible candidate to run World Economic Forum departs ECB nine months early, saying she wants to speak her mind about world affairs</p><p>Christine Lagarde, the eurozone’s top central banker, has said she is stepping down nine months early to speak her mind about world affairs and confront the “misrepresentation of the truth”.</p><p>Ending months of speculation about her future at the European Central Bank, Lagarde said she would quit her role as president in March rather than October next year because the rules of neutrality that governed her job prevented her from influencing debate about financial and economics affairs.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/29/european-central-bank-chief-christine-lagarde-to-step-down-nine-months-early">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Critics warn of climate danger as president in Texas claims change will save companies and consumers billions</p><p>Donald Trump said his administration was “terminating” Biden-era regulations holding oil and gas companies accountable for large leaks of planet-warming methane during a rally in Lubbock, Texas, on Tuesday evening.</p><p>“Tonight, I’m officially terminating Biden’s expensive and unnecessary methane regulations to save consumers and energy producers,” Trump said, lifting what he called “crippling regulations on methane that caused prices to skyrocket” for small oil and gas operators. The change would save consumers and energy producers $45bn and unlock 210m barrels of oil, he said, which is equivalent to about 10 days of US petroleum consumption.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/27/trump-biden-era-methane-emissions-rules-oil-gas">Continue reading...</a></description>
